key_reasoning.reason: Touches the SSO detached-login lock (new succeeded/failed stamping and waitForDetachedSsoLogin poller), the shared SSO auth gate (new ensureCodeMieSsoAuthOrWait), the sso-login bin, the SSO session-expiry proxy plugin, the `codemie hook` CLI command, the claude-code-otlp proxy connector, three OTLP adapters (claude-code-otlp, copilot-chat-otlp, copilot-cli-otlp) and Claude/Gemini hook configs. Base L (3-4+ components across provider/CLI/agent layers with a shared utility), bumped for affecting multiple agents/workflows.

Closest pattern is the existing detached sign-in lock (acquireLock/cooldown); the change extends it with cross-process polling on a lock file, mid-write race tolerance and auth-gate re-checks after another profile's login. Base M, bumped to L because it sits on the authentication path (prompt gating on SSO credentials).

24 files changed (749+/65-) per diffstat, which maps to XXL under the 16+ actual-mode band; roughly half are tests (2 new SSO test files, new hook auth-gate-wait and prompt-hook-timeouts tests), spanning src/providers, src/cli, src/agents, src/bin and tests/integration.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): affects multiple workflows/agents (Claude, Gemini, claude-code-otlp, copilot-chat-otlp, copilot-cli-otlp hook paths).
Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): affects authentication (SSO prompt gate waits on and re-validates sign-in).
